text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—No one should be here,
yet I feel eyes on my back...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curious, I looked back and saw
a row of Umamusume plushies seated on the bench.
choice_data_list: What on earth is this doll...?

text_block_list.text:
Are you intrigued?
By the Machan Doll Prototype Squadron.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes, because Machan is going to become an ultra-super mascot remembered by everyone all over the world.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sewing all kinds of Machan dolls every single day
so that I'm ready whenever an offer for merchandise comes in, ahem.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And I'm already carrying out grassroots promotional
activities right now: Machan Commercials.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What you just witnessed was, well, exactly that.
A whole row of Machans on a bench――an intense visual tactic designed to sear itself right into your mind.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And it was a resounding success.
You're curious about the Machans now, aren't you?
choice_data_list: D-Does she actually have a point...?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Don't you want one? The Machan Doll,
the perfect companion for training.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think practicing under the watchful gaze of these lovely eyes
is guaranteed to get you super pumped and energized?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: True, when you're gazed upon by the round, innocent eyes of the Machan dolls...
choice_data_list: Knowing someone's watching keeps you running sharp.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes, Machan is a lovely and soothing Umamusume, so the Machan doll is also a lovely and soothing doll.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best, do your best, one more round☆
The lovely Machan Doll is cheering you on♪"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you, Machan Doll!
You're so super cute, all my tiredness just melts away~~"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Like that, not just one per household,
but one Machan doll per Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, Project Machan seems to be proceeding smoothly. Sankyuu a lot for your valuable input.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Machan, here to cheer for your heart.
When the official release is set, please be sure to check it out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't entirely sure what was happening, but it seemed
I had managed to be of help to her plan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: My, Machan thought she was acting as a soothing cheerleader Machan, but――

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: To think it also helped supervise our training...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "Keep up the brisk pace~! This Machan Doll is watching your every move...!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A stern Machan wearing a headband
and wielding a bamboo sword edition...
That works, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Even without Trainer around, you'll stay fully motivated with Drill Sergeant Machan!"
...Let's go with that concept.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, we've gained more ideas for merchandise.
Project Machan is progressing smoothly as planned.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Thanks a lot for your valuable input.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't entirely sure what was happening, but it seemed
I had managed to be of help to her plan.
